Name: Juliet and Jessie in Nyapu's Style
Author: PureJJoy
Description:
I started a new save recently and realized that Juliet and Jessie didn't have a nyapu version with their seasonal outfits. Juliet wasn't that much of a problem since she has almost all of her outfits in the original mod and in the og Nyapu Portraits, but poor Jessie didn't have anything 😢 So with my amateur skills in pixel art and excessive amount of free time (unemployed and chronically ill 🙃) I drew all of her outfits! (except for fall, because is her og outfit).

How to Install:

1. Download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045?tab=files&file_id=76302]Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp[/url] ( the Joja Clerks file) and put it in your mod file
2. Download this mod and unzip
3. Then pick up the folders in [i]Nyapu Seasonal Cute Juliet and Jessie\assets\Portraits [/i]and replace the folders in Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters Juliet and Jessie\assets\Portraits
4. Say yes to "replace the folders" and you're done!

Credits: 
The Seasonal fits belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Poltergeister[/url]
The Original mod for Juliet and Jessie belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]lemurkat[/url]
And the base portraits that I edited belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu[/url]
